title: Patronus Evaluation Tools
summary: This module provides tools for integrating with Patronus AI to evaluate LLM agent interactions. It offers options for dynamic API-based evaluation, local custom function evaluation, and API-based evaluation with predefined criteria.

nodes.label: Agent Input/Output Data
nodes.title: Agent Interaction Data
nodes.description: Input, output, and context data generated by an agent that needs to be evaluated for performance or quality.

nodes.label: Patronus Eval Tool
nodes.title: Dynamic Patronus Evaluation
nodes.description: Allows agents to dynamically select appropriate evaluators and criteria from the Patronus AI API to assess their interactions.

nodes.label: Patronus Local Eval Tool
nodes.title: Local Custom Evaluation
nodes.description: Facilitates evaluation of agent interactions using custom local function evaluators, requiring the 'patronus' Python package.

nodes.label: Patronus Predefined Eval Tool
nodes.title: Predefined Patronus Evaluation
nodes.description: Evaluates agent interactions against the Patronus AI API using a fixed set of predefined evaluators and criteria, ensuring consistent assessment.

nodes.label: Patronus AI API
nodes.title: External Patronus Evaluation Service
nodes.description: The external Patronus AI service that provides evaluation capabilities, manages available evaluators, and defines criteria for assessment.

nodes.label: Local Evaluation Engine
nodes.title: Local Custom Evaluation Execution
nodes.description: The local environment or framework responsible for executing custom evaluation functions provided via the Patronus Python client.

nodes.label: Evaluation Results
nodes.title: Agent Evaluation Outcomes
nodes.description: Structured output containing evaluation scores, pass/fail status, and detailed explanations of the agent's performance.

nodes.label: Patronus API Key
nodes.title: API Authentication Credential
nodes.description: An authentication key required to securely access and utilize the Patronus AI API for evaluation services.

nodes.label: Patronus Client Object
nodes.title: Local Patronus Client
nodes.description: A Python client object used to initialize and interact with local Patronus evaluation functionalities and custom evaluators.

groups.label: Evaluation Tools
groups.title: Core Evaluation Components
groups.description: The primary tools provided by the module for initiating and managing different types of agent evaluations.

groups.label: Evaluation Data & Config
groups.title: Data Flow and Configuration
groups.description: Components representing the inputs, outputs, and configuration elements involved in the evaluation process.

groups.label: External Services
groups.title: External Evaluation Dependencies
groups.description: External systems and engines that the evaluation tools interact with to perform their functions.
